en.headline: Woman found dead in Ta Kwu Ling with suspected animal bite marks
en.dek: Police are investigating after a 33-year-old woman was discovered collapsed outside a village house near a dog training centre and boarding facility on Thursday afternoon.
body: Police received a report at about 4.12 p.m. on Thursday that a woman was lying unconscious outside a village house on Ping Yuen Road in Ping Yeung San Tsuen, Ta Kwu Ling. Paramedics pronounced her dead at the scene.

Officers said a preliminary examination showed suspected animal bite marks on the body. The incident occurred near a pet hotel and dog training centre. Police have classified the case as a dead-body discovery and are investigating the cause of death.

Forensic and Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department personnel attended the scene. The identity of the deceased and the precise circumstances remain under inquiry; a full autopsy will be required to determine the cause of death.

zh.headline: 打鼓嶺女子伏屍村屋外 身上疑有動物咬噬痕跡
zh.dek: 一名33歲女子周四下午在坪洋新村坪原路一村屋外被發現倒臥，當場證實死亡，屍體有懷疑動物咬噬痕跡，警方正調查。
body: 警方周四下午約4時12分接報，指打鼓嶺坪原路坪洋新村一村屋外有女子倒臥昏迷。救護人員到場後證實該名33歲女子已死亡。
初步檢查發現死者身上有懷疑被動物咬噬的痕跡。事發位置附近有寵物酒店及犬隻訓練中心。案件暫列屍體發現，警方正調查死因。
鑑證人員及漁護署人員其後到場協助。死者身份及確實情況仍在調查中，需經解剖確定死因。
